title: Edmund and the Machine
author: T. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Oscar Almeida, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
